projects.title: EduBrave Learning Portal
projects.tagline: Multi-role academy portal with realtime schedule sync, GraphQL data connect, and automated report generation.
projects.summary: Unified digital portal serving students, instructors, and academy staff with role-based access, attendance tracking, and instant grade synchronization.
projects.overview: EduBrave was engineered to eliminate communication fragmentation and spreadsheet chaos across training centers. It provides a cohesive Next.js 16 web app and responsive mobile interface backed by PostgreSQL and GraphQL via Firebase Data Connect, facilitating real-time course enrollment, assignment uploads, and attendance tracking.
projects.problem: Educational centers struggled with manual tracking of student cohorts, slow grading feedback loops, and desynchronized timetable data across disparate software tools.
projects.solution: Architected a unified responsive web and mobile application utilizing Next.js 16 with role-based permissions (RBAC), realtime attendance syncing, and GraphQL data layers backed by PostgreSQL.
architectureHighlights: Role-based authentication & route guards (Student, Teacher, Admin)
Real-time schedule synchronization with GraphQL subscriptions
Automated PDF grade report generation and asynchronous export
Optimized mobile layout with touch-friendly navigation
keyFeatures: Interactive cohort scheduling calendar with collision detection
Automated grading dashboards with instant student push notifications
Batch CSV student onboarding with automated credential distribution
Audited activity logs for institutional compliance

projects.title: TerraRun Cloud Orchestrator
projects.tagline: Automated GCP Cloud Run container deployment engine with Terraform Infrastructure as Code and GitHub Actions.
projects.summary: Declarative multi-environment cloud infrastructure automation delivering zero-downtime rolling container releases on Google Cloud.
projects.overview: TerraRun is an enterprise-grade cloud deployment scaffold utilizing Terraform to provision GCP VPCs, Cloud Run instances, Secret Manager credentials, and Cloud Build CI/CD triggers. It enforces GitOps best practices and immutable container deployment standards.
projects.problem: Manual cloud deployments incurred configuration drift between staging and production environments, leading to fragile releases and downtime risks.
projects.solution: Constructed fully automated, modular Terraform configurations with automated pull-request validation, preview environments, and blue-green Cloud Run container promotions.
architectureHighlights: Modular Terraform IaC separating network, database, and compute layers
Container vulnerability scanning with Trivy in CI pipelines
Automated preview URLs for pull requests before staging merges
Granular GCP IAM least-privilege service accounts
keyFeatures: Automated Terraform plan outputs posted as PR comments
Instant rollback trigger with historical container tag locking
Centralized Google Cloud Secret Manager integration with automated rotation
Cost estimation alerts via Terraform Infracost hooks

projects.title: PulseAI Copilot & Knowledge Engine
projects.tagline: Multimodal intelligent agent engine with hybrid vector search, context caching, and real-time streaming.
projects.summary: Next-generation autonomous assistant capable of answering complex domain questions with verifiable citations and interactive tools.
projects.overview: PulseAI is an open-source agent framework combining semantic embeddings, hybrid keyword + vector retrieval, and fast token streaming for technical customer support and documentation search.
projects.problem: Generic LLM chatbots suffer from hallucinated answers, lack of private domain knowledge, and slow non-streamed responses.
projects.solution: Built a Python & TypeScript hybrid system utilizing semantic indexing, context caching, and a low-latency streaming API with human-in-the-loop fallback.
architectureHighlights: Hybrid vector and BM25 lexical search ranking for pinpoint accuracy
Custom tool execution engine with sandboxed evaluation
Full citation verification and confidence scoring
keyFeatures: Dynamic prompt compression with sliding window context management
Interactive document preview with inline sentence highlight references
Fallback routing to human engineering team on low-confidence queries
Real-time token usage telemetry and cost monitoring
